arxiv-2106-13627.creator: Shuo Wang Zhaopeng Tu Zhixing Tan Wenxuan Wang Maosong Sun Yang Liu
arxiv-2106-13627.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Shuo Wang Zhaopeng Tu Zhixing Tan Wenxuan Wang Maosong Sun Yang Liu. Recent years have witnessed the rapid advance in neural machine translation (NMT), the core of which lies in the encoder-decoder architecture. arxiv-2109-13581.title: Protocol for temperature sensing using a three-level transmon circuit
arxiv-2109-13581.creator: Aidar Sultanov, Marko Kuzmanović, Andrey V. Lebedev, Gheorghe Sorin Paraoanu
arxiv-2109-13581.description: Abstract Abstract We present a method for in situ temperature measurement of superconducting quantum circuits, by using the first three levels of a transmon device to which we apply a sequence of π \pi gates. Our approach employs projective dispersive readout and utilizes the basic properties of the density matrix associated with thermal states.

arxiv-2109-15217.title: On fast convergence rates for generalized conditional gradient methods with backtracking stepsize Thanks: Karl Kunisch was supported by the ERC advanced grant 668998 (OCLOC) under the EU’s H2020 research program.
arxiv-2109-15217.creator: Karl Kunisch, Daniel Walter
arxiv-2109-15217.description: Abstract . A generalized conditional gradient method for minimizing the sum of two convex functions, one of them differentiable, is presented. This iterative method relies on two main ingredients: First, the minimization of a partially linearized objective functional to compute a descent direction and, second, a stepsize choice based on an Armijo-like condition to ensure sufficient descent in every iteration.

arxiv-2402-04312.title: M T ​ N M_{TN} is all you need: production of multiple semi-invisible resonances at hadron colliders Journal: Physics Letters B
arxiv-2402-04312.creator: Zhongtian Dong, Kyoungchul Kong, Konstantin T. Matchev, Katia Matcheva
arxiv-2402-04312.description: Abstract The stransverse mass variable M T ​ 2 M_{T2} was originally proposed for the study of hadron collider events in which N = 2 N=2 parent particles are produced and then decay semi-invisibly. Here we consider the generalization to the case of N ≥ 3 N\geq 3 semi-invisibly decaying parent particles.

arxiv-2406-08194.title: Simulated Coronal Mass Ejections on a young Solar-Type Star and the Associated Instantaneous Angular Momentum Loss
arxiv-2406-08194.creator: Yu Xu, Julián D. Alvarado-Gómez, Hui Tian, Katja Poppenhäger, Gustavo Guerrero, Xianyu Liu
arxiv-2406-08194.description: Abstract Coronal mass ejections (CMEs) on stars can change the stars’ magnetic field configurations and mass loss rates during the eruption and propagation and therefore, may affect the stars’ rotation properties on long time-scales. The dynamics of stellar CMEs and their influence on the stellar angular momentum loss rate are not yet well understood.

arxiv-2505-18885.title: The Parameterized Complexity of Computing the Linear Vertex Arboricity Thanks: This is a shortened version of the master’s thesis of the first author [ 10 ] .
arxiv-2505-18885.creator: Alexander Erhardt, Alexander Wolff
arxiv-2505-18885.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alexander Erhardt, Alexander Wolff. The linear vertex arboricity of a graph is the smallest number of sets into which the vertices of a graph can be partitioned so that each of these sets induces a linear forest.

arxiv-2510-14937.title: AI-Powered Early Diagnosis of Mental Health Disorders from Real-World Clinical Conversations
arxiv-2510-14937.creator: Jianfeng Zhu, Julina Maharjan, Xinyu Li, Karin G. Coifman, Ruoming Jin
arxiv-2510-14937.description: Abstract Mental health disorders remain among the leading cause of disability worldwide, yet conditions such as depression, anxiety, and Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) are frequently underdiagnosed or misdiagnosed due to subjective assessments, limited clinical resources, and stigma and low awareness.

pmc-10575898.title: Gut Bacteroides act in a microbial consortium to cause susceptibility to severe malaria
pmc-10575898.creator: Rabindra K Mandal, Anita Mandal, Joshua E Denny, Ruth Namazii, Chandy C John, Nathan W Schmidt
pmc-10575898.description: Malaria is caused by Plasmodium species and remains a significant cause of morbidity and mortality globally. Gut bacteria can influence the severity of malaria, but the contribution of specific bacteria to the risk of severe malaria is unknown. Here, multiomics approaches demonstrate that specific species of Bacteroides are causally linked to the risk of severe malaria.

pmc-10738352.title: QUALITY-OF-LIFE INDICATORS IN CAREGIVERS OF OLDER ADULTS WITH DEMENTIA: CATEGORIZATION USING THE WHO-ICF
pmc-10738352.creator: Idorenyin Udoh, Elias Mpofu
pmc-10738352.description: The quality of life of caregivers of persons with dementia greatly influences their health, physical, psychological, and emotional wellbeing. This in turn influences the quality of care they deliver to persons with dementia. This scoping review aimed to map emerging evidence on the quality of life indicators using service and environmental support factors and a subsequent characterization using the WHO-ICF.

pmc-11290763.title: Current insights into human pathogenic phenuiviruses and the host immune system
pmc-11290763.creator: Chuan-Min Zhou, Ze-Zheng Jiang, Ning Liu, Xue-Jie Yu
pmc-11290763.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Phenuiviruses are a class of segmented negative-sense single-stranded RNA viruses, typically consisting of three RNA segments that encode four distinct proteins. The emergence of pathogenic phenuivirus strains, such as Rift Valley fever phlebovirus (RVFV) in sub-Saharan Africa, Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome Virus (SFTSV) in East and Southeast Asia, and Heartland Virus (HRTV) in the United States has presented considerable challenges to global public health in recent years.

pmc-11339062.title: A comprehensive foodomics analysis of rambutan seed oils: Focusing on the physicochemical parameters, lipid concomitants and lipid profiles
pmc-11339062.creator: Jingtao Cui, Siqi Zhao, Yanchi Zhou, Tian Li, Weimin Zhang
pmc-11339062.description: A foodomics approach was employed to systematically characterize and compare the quality parameters, antioxidant activity, minor-components, fatty acid composition, and lipid profiles of the seed oils from the three most popular rambutan varieties in China. The total lipid content ranged from 23.40 to 25.77 g/100 g. The fatty acids 9cC18:1 (39.84%–40.92%) and C20:0 (28.45%–30.

pmc-11415829.title: Correlation of anogenital distance from childhood to age 9 years—a prospective population-based birth cohort—the Odense Child Cohort
pmc-11415829.creator: Sarah Munk Andreasen, Lise Gehrt, Casper P Hagen, Anders Juul, Gylli Mola, Margit Bistrup Fischer, Marianne Skovsager Andersen, David Møbjerg Kristensen, Tina Kold Jensen
pmc-11415829.description: STUDY QUESTIONDoes anogenital distance (AGD) – distance from the anus to the genitals – correlate from infancy (3 months) to the age of 9 years in boys and girls?SUMMARY ANSWERIn boys, AGD correlated from infancy to 9 years of age, whereas in girls, correlations were weaker, especially between infancy and later childhood.

pmc-11431531.title: Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) in Digestive Healthcare: Regulatory Challenges and Ethical Implications
pmc-11431531.creator: Miguel Mascarenhas, Miguel Martins, Tiago Ribeiro, João Afonso, Pedro Cardoso, Francisco Mendes, Hélder Cardoso, Rute Almeida, João Ferreira, João Fonseca, Guilherme Macedo, Dechang Chen
pmc-11431531.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The growing integration of software in healthcare, particularly the rise of standalone software as a medical device (SaMD), is transforming digestive medicine, a field heavily reliant on medical imaging for both diagnosis and therapeutic interventions. This narrative review aims to explore the impact of SaMD on digestive healthcare, focusing on the evolution of these tools and their regulatory and ethical challenges.

pmc-11510968.title: Factors Influencing the Variation of Plants’ Cardinal Temperature: A Case Study in Iran
pmc-11510968.creator: Sima Sohrabi, Javid Gherekhloo, Saeid Hassanpour-bourkheili, Afshin Soltani, Jose L Gonzalez-Andujar, Congyan Wang, Hongli Li
pmc-11510968.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The establishment and spread of plants in their native or alien geographical ranges are determined by their germination. This study investigated the impact of different factors on variations in cardinal temperatures. We used the lm procedure and measured the effect size by the Eta-square approach to find the association of different factors (species, ecotypes, origin (native/alien), year, and life cycle) with the cardinal temperatures of 31 species. Our results showed that the base, optimum, and maximum temperatures responded differently to these factors.

pmc-11521209.title: Nongenetic Risk Factors of Severe Hypospadias: A Case–Control Study
pmc-11521209.creator: Vita Indriasari, Rizki Diposarosa, Yoni Fuadah Syukriani, Dedi Rachmadi
pmc-11521209.description: Background:Various risk factors were contributed to hypospadias and may be varied by region and hypospadias severity. The study aims to analyze the nongenetic risk factors associated with severe hypospadias in a provincial referral hospital in West Java, Indonesia.Methods:A case–control study was conducted in hypospadias patients and boys with normal penis treated in our institution during 6-month period.

pmc-11570760.title: The Impact of Food Specific IgG Antibodies on Migraine and Its Comorbidities
pmc-11570760.creator: Zhi‐Ming Zhao, Mei‐Mei Yang, Xian‐Shu Zhao, Fu‐Jun Wan, Bao‐Li Ning, Li‐Ming Zhang, Jun Fu
pmc-11570760.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the differences in headache and comorbidity symptoms between migraine patients with negative and positive food specific IgG antibodies, and explore the correlation between these symptoms with food specific IgG antibodies.MethodsA total of 129 migraine patients were enrolled. Seven questionnaires were used to gather information regarding the symptoms of migraine, gastrointestinal, depression, anxiety, and sleep.

pmc-12452580.title: Total-Arterial Revascularization Is Superior in Heart Failure Patients with Reduced Ejection Fraction—A Propensity Score Matched Retrospective Multicenter Analysis
pmc-12452580.creator: Christian Jörg Rustenbach, Julia Schano, Christoph Salewski, Helene Häberle, Kristian-Christos Ngamsri, Ilija Djordjevic, Stefanie Wendt, Tulio Caldonazo, Ibrahim Saqer, Shekhar Saha, Philipp Schnackenburg, Lina Maria Serna-Higuita, Torsten Doenst, Christian Hagl, Thorsten Wahlers, Christian Schlens
pmc-12452580.description: Background: Total arterial revascularization (TAR) may improve outcomes in patients with ischemic cardiomyopathy and heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF). Methods: We retrospectively screened 574 adults with HFrEF (LVEF < 40%) undergoing isolated CABG across four German centers (2017–2023). After 1:1 propensity score matching, 240 patients were analyzed (120 TAR vs. 120 NTAR).

pmc-12453536.title: Tissue sample taken by transbronchial biopsy in the diagnosis of tuberculosis; benefits-risks
pmc-12453536.creator: Bilal Rabahoğlu, Nuri Tutar, Burcu Baran, Nur A. Yetkin, Fatma S. Oymak, İnci Gülmez
pmc-12453536.description: Objectives:Tuberculosis (TB) poses a serious health risk in Turkey and globally and is often difficult to diagnose. It may be sometimes necessary to obtain bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) and, in some cases, biopsy samples via bronchoscopy to acquire an adequate sample. Our aim is to assess the contribution of transbronchial lung biopsy (TBLB) alongside BAL in diagnosing TB.

pmc-12466514.title: Box–Behnken Design Optimization of Green Extraction from Tomato Aerial Parts and Axillary Shoots for Enhanced Recovery of Rutin and Complementary Bioactive Compounds
pmc-12466514.creator: Simona Marcu Spinu, Mihaela Dragoi Cudalbeanu, Nikola Major, Smiljana Goreta Ban, Igor Palčić, Alina Ortan, Petronela Mihaela Rosu, Narcisa Elena Babeanu
pmc-12466514.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Tomato aerial parts and axillary shoots represent underutilized agricultural residues with promising phytochemical potential. Despite the recognized antioxidant capacity of rutin, current literature lacks optimized, comparative studies on its extraction from distinct tomato vegetative components. This study aimed to maximize the recovery of rutin and other bioactive compounds from tomato plant biomass using green extraction techniques—microwave-assisted extraction (MAE) and ultrasound-assisted extraction (UAE)—optimized through Box–Behnken design (BBD) and Response Surface Methodology (RSM).

pmc-12733863.title: Effects of Trehalose-6-Phosphate Synthase on the Reproduction and Development of Nilaparvata lugens and Its Molecular Mechanism
pmc-12733863.creator: Ye Han, Fan Zhong, Xinyu Zhang, Yuya Zhang, Yanfei Zhou, Liwen Guan, Yongkang Liu, Yi Zhang, Xinyi Zhang, Min Zhou, Bin Tang, Shaojin Wang, Liling Yang
pmc-12733863.description: Simple SummaryNilaparvata lugens (Brown rice planthopper, BPH), a migratory rice pest with strong fecundity and insecticide resistance, severely threatens global rice production. This study aimed to explore how trehalose-6-phosphate synthase—a key gene in trehalose biosynthesis—affects N. lugens’s reproduction and related molecular mechanisms. We used RNA interference (RNAi) to silence three trehalose-6-phosphate synthase paralogs (TPS1, TPS2, TPS3) in female N. lugens.

pmc-12768823.title: PD20 Evaluation Of Diagnostic Methods For Visceral Leishmaniasis Detection: A Systematic Review
pmc-12768823.creator: Mariana del Grossi, Bruna Santos, Stéfani Borges, Daniela Melo
pmc-12768823.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionVisceral leishmaniasis (VL), caused by Leishmania infantum, is a significant public health challenge in the Americas and the Mediterranean basin. Effective disease control requires timely and accurate diagnostic methods, particularly in endemic regions.

pmc-13067866.title: Safety and efficacy of a feed additive consisting of l‐histidine monohydrochloride monohydrate produced with Escherichia coli CCTCC M 20241089 for all animal species (Anhui Huaheng Biotechnology Co., Ltd)

pmc-13103870.title: The Impact of Endoscopic Ultrasound and Multidisciplinary Team Evaluation on the Management of Pancreatic Cystic Lesions
pmc-13103870.creator: Mohamad Dbouk, Osama Altayar, Mark J. Hoegger, Juan Reyes Genere, Arvind Rengarajan, Vincent M. Mellnick, Anup S. Shetty, Linda Chu, Atif Zaheer, Ghazal Zandieh, Vladimir Kushnir, Gabriel Lang, Michael Goggins, William Hawkins, Adeel Khan, William Burns, Kelly Lafaro, Kian‐Huat Lim, Katrina Pederson
pmc-13103870.description: BackgroundRetrospective evaluations of multidisciplinary team (MDT) review of pancreatic cystic lesions (PCL) demonstrate improved PCL management. Endoscopic ultrasound (EUS) evaluates PCL for worrisome features; however, its influence on MDT is unclear and may be attenuated by anchoring/confirmation bias. We aimed to evaluate the impact of EUS and the overall performance of MDT evaluation of PCL.

pmc-13171501.title: Genome-wide identification of the CmHDZ gene family in Chinese chestnut (Castanea mollissima) and analysis of their expression patterns under different types of abiotic stress
pmc-13171501.creator: Xiurong Xu, Shiming Cheng
pmc-13171501.description: The members of the homologous homeodomain-leucine zipper (HDZ) family of transcription factors play important roles in the ability of plants to cope with adverse conditions. In this study, we analyzed the genome of the Chinese chestnut (Castanea mollissima) to identify the CmHDZ genes involved in stress response.

pmc-13179602.title: Translation and validation of the German version of the Chronic Otitis Media Questionnaire-12 (COMQ-12): a psychometric analysis
pmc-13179602.creator: Michael Knoke, Marcus Neudert, Thomas Zahnert, Susen Lailach
pmc-13179602.description: BackgroundThe Chronic Otitis Media Questionnaire-12 (COMQ-12) is a disease-specific health-related quality of life (HRQoL) instrument originally developed in English for patients with chronic otitis media (COM). This study aimed to translate the COMQ-12 into German and to validate the resulting German version, and assess its psychometric properties.MethodsThe COMQ-12 underwent forward–backward translation into German.

pmc-13356117.title: Integration of Suicide Prevention Training into the Preclinical Medical School Curriculum
pmc-13356117.creator: Riya Chhabra, Shivapriya Chandu, Ahmad Abu-Mahfouz, Kristin Sarsfield, Berkley Browne-Holtz
pmc-13356117.description: According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, in 2023, 1.5 million adults attempted suicide (1). To address this mental health emergency, suicide prevention workshops have been introduced to resident physicians (5). However there exists a gap in suicide education for medical students, especially in the preclinical years.

pmc-13514359.title: Deaf Child Signers’ Reading Behaviors Are Predicted by Their Bilingual (Signed and Spoken) Vocabularies: Evidence from Eye-Tracking
pmc-13514359.creator: Frances G. Cooley, David Quinto-Pozos
pmc-13514359.description: Deaf children who acquire a signed language at home and at school prior to learning to read are a unique group of developing bilinguals. They are first-language users of a signed language (e.g., American Sign Language; ASL) and second-language users of the written form of the ambient spoken language (e.g., English).

pmc-13529405.title: Autofluorescence Imaging and Methylene Blue‐Mediated Photodynamic Therapy for Early Detection and Management of Subclinical Actinic Cheilitis
pmc-13529405.creator: Juliana Cristina Oliverio de Araújo, Og Fray Junior, Hermano Camelo Paiva, Alyne Simões Gonçalves, Martha Simões Ribeiro
pmc-13529405.description: ObjectivesOptical autofluorescence imaging is a noninvasive adjunct for detecting potentially malignant oral disorders, such as actinic cheilitis (AC). This study evaluated its use for early detection and for monitoring tissue response following methylene blue‐mediated photodynamic therapy (MB‐PDT).MethodsLip autofluorescence was assessed using a handheld device (405 ± 20 nm). Areas with altered fluorescence underwent biopsy for confirmation.

pmc-13644939.title: Working with goals in youth mental health and substance use service: A review of current practice guidelines and recommendations
pmc-13644939.creator: Madison Nugent, Drew Burchell, Jill Chorney, Sharon Clark, Mick Cooper, Debbie Emberly, Danielle Impey, Jenna Jacob, Anam Khan, Jennifer Lane, Duncan Law, Rebecca Pillai Riddell, Lori Wozney
pmc-13644939.description: BackgroundWorking with goals is a critical yet often overlooked aspect of youth mental health and addictions care, with the potential to strengthen therapeutic relationships, support shared decision‐making, and improve outcomes. Despite its importance, there is no cohesive, equity‐centered guidance for working with youth on their goals.
